search_text: published ZDI-20-1205 ZDI-CAN-10595 Microhard Bullet-LTE Ping Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-08-26 CVE-2020-17406 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-17406 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Microhard'] ['Bullet-LTE'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Microhard Bullet-LTE. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the ping parameter provided to tools.sh. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Fixed in R112 ['2020-03-03 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2020-08-26 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2020-09-17 - Advisory Updated'] Ricky "HeadlessZeke" Lawshae https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-20-1205/
title: Microhard Bullet-LTE Ping Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Microhard Bullet-LTE. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the ping parameter provided to tools.sh. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
